active_phase.immediate_objective: Bring the versioned Archetype-A reference fixture docs/ui/fixtures/op-detail-compacto/OP Detail - Compacto.dc.html into conformance with the canonical visual foundation, changing visual values and structural conformance only and preserving the already approved compact geometry. CORRECTION ROUND. The status recorded at 2641a44 was inaccurate and is corrected forward, not rewritten; docs/ledgers/G28_LEDGER.md owns the full record of both rounds. THREE DEFECTS WERE CORRECTED. (1) OFFLINE RUNTIME: support.js booted React from a public CDN, so with no internet the reference rendered a blank page - 0 characters of visible text and 0 rendered cards. react and react-dom 18.3.1, both MIT, are now versioned under docs/ui/fixtures/vendor/react-18.3.1/, promoted byte-for-byte from the official npm packages and loaded before support.js, which short-circuits on its existing-globals check; support.js was NOT modified. Package, version, license, registry integrity, per-file digests and byte counts are recorded in that directory's README.md, and the digests also reproduce the Subresource Integrity values support.js already pinned for the CDN copies, which is independent proof nothing was substituted or rebuilt. ARCHITECT CLASSIFICATION: IMMUTABLE THIRD-PARTY FIXTURE RUNTIME ASSETS - not project-authored source, therefore outside the CODE_HEALTH_RULES.md section 7 source-size thresholds; CODE_HEALTH_RULES.md was NOT modified and the vendor README plus the ledger entry are the custody record. Not authorized by that ruling: vendor modification, minified code as project-source precedent, application-runtime imports, further vendored dependencies, or a version upgrade. (2) STATUS PILL: now follows contract 2.6 exactly - height 18px, padding 0 6px, 1px var(--rv-pill-caution-border), radius var(--rv-radius-pill), caution background and text, font-size var(--rv-fs-2xs), dot 6px to 5px - because the normative component contract prevails over a geometry freeze that was only ever meant to protect layout. (3) COUNT BADGE: the literal font-size 10px, below the section 5 type floor of 10.5px, is now var(--rv-fs-thead), so the fixture has zero out-of-enum font sizes. TWO NORMATIVE CLARIFICATIONS CARRY THEM, neither inventing a token or a value. D6.1 in DESIGN_DECISIONS.md, mirrored into UI_VISUAL_CONTRACT.md section 5, scopes --rv-radius-pill to semantic pills - status pill, stage badge, count badge - AND true circular geometry - status dot, timeline dot, avatar - and forbids it on an ordinary button, card, control, section chip or rectangular decorative box; D6 is not rewritten and 999px does not change. UI_VISUAL_CONTRACT.md section 2.5.1 rules that a non-mutating contextual navigation link may remain in a section header, is not an action, and must not carry data-card-actions. EXACTLY TEN IMPLEMENTATION PATHS: the fixture; the four vendor files; tests/ui-op-detail-compacto-fixture.test.mjs; tests/ui-foundation-validator.test.mjs; css/tokens.css, changed by COMMENT ONLY on the --rv-radius-pill declaration; UI_VISUAL_CONTRACT.md; DESIGN_DECISIONS.md. support.js, scripts/validate-ui-foundation.mjs, scripts/ui-foundation/**, docs/ui/evidence/**, assets/brand/**, js/**, db/**, index.html, css/responsive.css, CODE_HEALTH_RULES.md and every other test are byte-identical to 2641a44. No token was invented, added, renamed or removed. SYNTHETIC-SCAFFOLD CORRECTION. tests/ui-foundation-validator.test.mjs failed 3 of 31 with two UIF-012 'Local dependency does not resolve' findings for the vendor files: the validator was right and the test scaffold was wrong, because it copies an inventory of files into a temp root and did not copy the newly authorized runtime. The authorized fix adds exactly two literal entries to its COPY array. Purely additive - no assertion, expected count, rule, threshold or exclusion changed, no validator production code touched, no mock substituted, and the scaffold copies the actual repository files byte-for-byte. VALIDATION: node --test tests/ui-op-detail-compacto-fixture.test.mjs -> 36/36; node --test tests/ui-foundation-validator.test.mjs -> 31/31; node scripts/validate-ui-foundation.mjs -> PASS errors=0 debt=335 with zero unresolved runtime tokens; node --test tests/*.js -> 4326 tests, 4325 pass / 1 fail, the sole failure the accepted external-corpus tests/g14-c-bridge-smoke.test.js at its byte-for-byte baseline; git diff --check and git diff --cached --check clean. Fixture contribution: literal colours 0, deprecated tokens 0, typography violations 0, semantic-radius violations 0, offline essential-runtime dependencies 0. GEOMETRY COMPARISON, MEASURED at 1440x900 and 1600x1000 in one Chromium build at scale 1 with every external origin blocked. Against the frozen 2641a44 geometry the shell is identical at both viewports - header 60, sidebar 190, rail 300, main padding 18px 32px 40px, grid tracks 870+300 and 1030+300, column gap 16, no horizontal overflow - the eight cards keep the same order and identical heights to the hundredth of a pixel, and visible text length is identical at 1315 characters, so no copy changed. The complete delta is the three intended corrections: the pill narrows 102.48px to 97.48px at an unchanged 18px height, the status dot goes 6px to 5px, and the count badge goes 10px/13px to 10.5px/14px. The historical f3ff4cb baseline measures the same shell and the same 1315 characters, so the chain f3ff4cb to 2641a44 to corrected changed values and never layout. DISCLOSED: the four images named in the previous submission were not present on disk at resume, so the set was recaptured under the ruled procedure rather than committed against absent evidence. Stronger than the ruled historical exception: instead of letting the f3ff4cb baseline load React from an external origin, it was rendered from a temp-only copy carrying the two local runtime script tags, so all four captures ran with every external origin blocked and both sides share the same runtime bytes. Architect VISUAL acceptance is NOT claimed.
